summary: Backend-only pytest suite (17 tests) covering auth (register/login/duplicates), /me GET & PATCH, taxonomy, sessions (list by month, next, create, patch, invalid id), and progress (muscle + exercise chart shape + stagnating flag). All 17 tests passed against the preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes POST /sessions (raw array Body) with PATCH /sessions/{id} (embed=True object body). Different body shapes for related endpoints is inconsistent but matches the frontend contract; keep for parity.
seed_demo is not idempotent for taxonomy/exercises but is idempotent for user (checks demo email). Fine for MVP.
get_current_user catches KeyError but not generic Exception; ObjectId(uid) with malformed sub falls under InvalidId — OK.
PATCH /sessions/{id} rewrites setlogs on every update (delete_many + insert). Acceptable for demo scale, could be optimized later.
clean_user leaks password_hash removal but does not sanitize on nested/embedded users — currently no such usage, OK.
seed_data_creation: Verified server startup seeds: 3-group TAXONOMY exercises + demo user with 6 entrenado (bench 80..100, tri 30 stagnant) + 4 planificado sessions in July 2026.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All GymBro backend endpoints tested via preview URL and passing. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py as regression. Tests create some TEST_-prefixed users and August 2026 sessions for demo user — not cleaned up (kept intentionally to avoid touching Mongo directly).
